name: morning-desk
description: Personalized daily news podcast: pick topics, trusted sources and a time, and get a short spoken briefing each morning. Next.js, Supabase, ElevenLabs, Vercel.

paragraphs: A daily news briefing read aloud. Create a profile, pick your topics, the outlets you trust and the time you listen, and each morning you get a short, radio-style spoken summary of the news made for you.
Status: Accounts and on-demand audio briefings working (step 5 of 7) · Daily automatic briefings next
features: Topics: Google News sections (World, Business, Tech, Sports…) plus your own search topics like "Formula 1".
Preferred sources: pick outlets you trust. Their recent stories come first, or turn on "only my sources".
Schedule: choose the time and days you listen. Your briefing is ready before then.
Voice and length: pick a voice style and a 3, 5 or 10 minute briefing.
Accounts: sign in with a link sent to your email, no password. Preferences follow you to any device.
